import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/dev')
import wire, hashlib
from run import run
v=wire.v
def h(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
# Initial with 8-byte overlong token length, overlong packet length
tok=b'\x01'*16
body1=b'\x06'+v(0)+v(3)+b'abc'
head1=bytes([0xc3])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([1])+b'\xaa'+bytes([1])+b'\xbb'+v(len(tok),8)+v(len(body1)+4,4)+b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'+body1
# Handshake with ack-ecn
ack=bytes([3])+v(2)+v(5)+v(2)+v(1)+v(2)+v(0)+v(7)+v(8)+v(9)
head2=bytes([0xe0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([1])+b'\xaa'+bytes([1])+b'\xbb'+v(len(ack)+1)+b'\x00'+ack
# application: path challenge, datagram with length, datagram without length, then app close with trailing garbage
pc=bytes([0x1a])+b'\x07'*8
dg1=bytes([0x31])+v(3)+b'xyz'
dg2=bytes([0x30])+b'zz'  # last data frame consumes remainder -> must be last before close
close=bytes([0x1d])+v(0x123)+v(2)+b'hi'
tail=b'\x00\xff'
body3=pc+dg1+close+tail
head3=bytes([0x44])+b'\xaa'+b'\x00'+body3   # phase=1
w=head1+head2+head3
ev=[{'keys':['I','H','A']}, wire.datagram(w,auth=[0,0,1])]
r=run({'traces':[wire.trace(ev)]})['traces'][0]
for p in r['packets']: print(p)
print('dgs',r['datagrams'])
print('crypto', [(c['level'],c['ranges'],c['unique'],c['prefix'],c['sha256']==h(b'abc')) for c in r['crypto']])
print('ack', [(a['level'],a['count'],a['intervals'],a['prefix'],a['sha256']==h(b''.join(
    __import__('struct').pack('>QQ',s,e) for s,e in [(1,3),(5,6)])),a['ecn']) for a in r['acknowledged']])
print('closed', r['closed'])
# expected canonical envelopes
cexp1=bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([1])+b'\xaa'+bytes([1])+b'\xbb'+v(16)+tok+v(1+len(body1))+b'\x00'+body1
cexp2=bytes([0xe0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([1])+b'\xaa'+bytes([1])+b'\xbb'+v(1+len(ack))+b'\x00'+ack
cexp3=bytes([0x44])+b'\xaa'+b'\x00'+pc+dg1+close
print('hash checks', h(cexp1)==r['packets'][0]['sha256'], h(cexp2)==r['packets'][1]['sha256'], h(cexp3)==r['packets'][2]['sha256'])
print('dg hash', h(cexp1+cexp2+cexp3)==r['datagrams'][0]['sha256'], r['datagrams'][0]['bytes']==len(cexp1+cexp2+cexp3))
print('concat hex', cexp3.hex())
